published.citation: Boucher et al. 2026, dayside temperature of the combined NIRSpec G395H phase-curve fit, 2048 +193 -206 K: 2048 +/- 206 K, https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21519

temperature.note: Its day side's brightness temperature is measured in secondary eclipse at 4 µm (JWST NIRSpec) and nobody has imaged it, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
temperature.chosen: the fit to both detectors together, 2.9 to 5.1 µm; the larger of its two errors is kept
